text.zh_CN: 前台刚送来一封手写挂号信和一只牛皮纸包裹，寄件人是远望一期的首位个人委托人——退休教师王先生。
text.en: Reception just brought up a handwritten registered letter and a kraft-paper parcel from Farview I's very first individual LP — retired teacher Mr. Wang.

text.zh_CN: 小友见字如面。这阵子大盘上上下下，我老伴每天看财经新闻都替我捏把汗，但我睡觉倒是很踏实。
text.en: Dear friend, the market has been tossing up and down lately. My wife worries every evening watching financial TV, yet I've been sleeping soundly.

text.zh_CN: 小友，这阵子基金净值一波动我就整宿睡不着。当初签约时你说过回撤很小、几乎稳赚不赔，可前两天账面浮亏吓得我老伴差点让我直接填赎回单……
text.en: Dear manager, every dip in the fund's NAV has kept me awake all night. When we signed, you assured me drawdowns would be tiny and practically smooth — two days ago my wife nearly had me submit an immediate redemption...

text.zh_CN: 小友见字如面！这阵子大盘颠簸，多亏签约那天你把‘最坏可能回撤两成’的丑话说在最前头，我心里早有准备，一点没慌。包裹里是老家今年新晒的桂花茶，给你们投研台提提神；另外我同教研组的周老师听说了你的实在作风，也想把他的养老闲钱托付给你。
text.en: Dear friend! Markets have been bumpy lately, and thank goodness you laid out the honest '20% worst-case drawdown' upfront on day one — I was mentally prepared and didn't panic a bit. Inside the parcel is fresh Osmanthus tea from my hometown for your desk; my retired colleague Teacher Zhou heard how candid you are and wants to invest with you too.

text.zh_CN: 合上王先生的来信，你准备如何回信与跟进客户沟通？
text.en: Closing Mr. Wang's letter, how do you reply and manage LP relations?

text.zh_CN: 附上详尽月度持仓风控简报，并审慎接纳周老师的低风险申购（+$30,000 AUM）。
text.en: Send a transparent monthly risk letter & onboard Teacher Zhou's conservative mandate (+$30,000 AUM).

toast.zh_CN: 口碑复利：王先生引荐周老师申购基金 $30,000
toast.en: Trust compounds: Teacher Zhou subscribed $30,000 via referral

text.zh_CN: 如实披露当前组合最大回撤与流动性缓冲，重申受托人风控红线。
text.en: Send full drawdown & liquidity-buffer disclosure, reaffirming fiduciary guardrails.

toast.zh_CN: 投后沟通：发出透明月度受托人报告
toast.en: Investor relations: Sent transparent monthly fiduciary letter

text.zh_CN: 看见了吗？在资产管理行业，诚实从来不是吃亏。你在顺境时少吹一句牛，危机来临时就少一张恐慌赎回单，多一份愿意陪你穿越牛熊的长钱。
text.en: See that? In asset management, candor is never a disadvantage. Every boast you hold back in good times saves you a panic redemption in bad times — and earns patient capital that stays through the cycle.

text.zh_CN: 亡羊补牢还不算晚。把真实波动率和止损底线写进每一封投资人月报里——只有把预期拉回地面，风暴真正来临时基金才不会被挤兑压垮。
text.en: Never too late to mend expectations. Put real volatility and drawdown guardrails into every LP letter — grounding expectations now is what keeps redemptions from breaking the fund in a storm.
